identified_problem: The frozen hard-negative authority spans complete canonical scene rows, but inactive or OOD rows are bitwise immutable AcceptedV2. A hard-negative pair whose two endpoints are both immutable cannot receive a residual update. Including those pairs in a training mean dilutes gradients on pairs with at least one trainable endpoint.

correction.training_pair_denominator: retain exactly authority pairs for which anchor_trainable OR negative_trainable
correction.validation_pair_denominator: all authority pairs, including pairs with two immutable endpoints
correction.response_profile_absolute_response_absol: retain all canonical rows because they audit the deployed complete-scene field and immutable rows remain exact controls
correction.typed_text_relation: retain all canonical rows; it is a same-region text-relation objective rather than a hard-negative endpoint-pair mean

required_audit.validation: report the same coverage diagnostically while objective_pair_count remains equal to authority_pair_count
